callees.name: _parse_caller
callees.pre_condition: caller_data is either None or a dict containing the fields required to construct a CallerSelector. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CallerSelector whose fqn and callsite_names are populated from the corresponding fields in caller_data. When caller_data is None or missing required fields, raises an error whose message includes source.

callees.name: _parse_callee
callees.pre_condition: callee_data is either None or a dict containing the fields required to construct a CalleeTarget. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CalleeTarget whose fqn and info_names are populated from the corresponding fields in callee_data. When callee_data is None or missing required fields, raises an error whose message includes source.

callees.name: _edge_source
callees.pre_condition: item is a dict that may contain evidence entries. source is a base provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a provenance string that incorporates available evidence information from item, or the original source string when no evidence is present.
